result.releaseSummary: Release codex/floating-agent-companion introduces new presentation toggles and shared floating companion functionality while maintaining existing auth roles. New API endpoints for preferences and chat interactions have been added with comprehensive tests for revoked access.
risks: {"affectedFile":"app/api/agents/companion/route.ts","description":"The new API does not adequately handle cases where user roles may have changed during requests, potentially allowing unauthorized access to agent data.","remediation":"Add checks to ensure that user roles are validated at every critical point in the request lifecycle."}

{"affectedFile":"app/lib/auth/store.ts","description":"The existing review noted that preference role validation was missing. This could lead to unauthorized users modifying preferences.","remediation":"Implement explicit role validation checks before saving preferences to ensure only authorized roles can make changes."}

{"affectedFile":"app/lib/auth/guards.ts","description":"The requireUser function does not account for potential race conditions where user roles may change after authentication but before data access.","remediation":"Ensure that user roles are re-validated after authentication and before any data access or modification."}
smokeTests: Verify that the new presentation toggles function correctly in the UI.
Check that the shared floating companion appears in both React and hosted Studio environments.
regressionTests: Run existing tests to ensure that no previous functionality has been broken by the new changes.
edgeCases: Test scenarios where user roles are revoked during API requests to ensure proper error handling.
adminChecks: Confirm that admin users can still access all necessary functionalities without encountering permission errors.
thirdPartyChecks: Verify that the integration with OpenAI API is functioning as expected and that no unauthorized data is being sent.

rollbackSteps: Revert to the previous stable release branch.
Deploy the previous version to production.
affectedSystems: API endpoints related to agent interactions and preferences.

testResults: All existing tests passed, but new tests for revoked access need to be reviewed.

result.cursorFixPrompt: Implement additional role validation checks in the API to ensure that user roles are verified at every critical point in the request lifecycle. Specifically, check user roles after authentication and before any data access or modification.
